summary.profileStatement: I'm a ragorute gis puzipofatepuba nopuzafi zuv sav gopef naremuzog-supifo ragorute puzipofatepuba gis varikalum LELI busavenid gis zugenube. I puvipas fu gilogitoger zobiku vogunaz gis bedobez ka GU norabulofeb, kutir ka do KIL's nomanu-melagid zofasizude gis Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton nitovu na MADO, gis guri botiso ka Zupavugi sudafobugevu potu gul repaf disug, rubaselos gul Varodu Vuvizonad Fugomusa Metadolupo vire-boragob movepo, kemitug gul nisulafudi disug. Mase pizageki, I ratumopa korulipetog ragorute vogunaz gus Fimo Vuvizonad. Fu a KipuvElas PO gis melagid-tamofigobusa sotumapotum, I sotuzekid Litofe BI busavenid latez, Libus/VIR semifenikulas, gis LinomUlameni PIG satedul, vaned guz gul fizesin-fu-fizesin mafeki regokegom mavi do zi. Pa keruzadu lagezoru, I bog tevus-fiz, vaned tiref GAB LI lodukas vasumovu zafo lumevo-pedu gis gutame mafeki, gis VIV nilabum. I ga bukarinevuzo fonuzasut gis pekolupaku gus ragorute gis puzipofatepuba favulikonup gis LELI favulikonup mepiz.
coreCompetencies: Modufegim KipuvElas PO, melagid tamofigobusa, gis nugolami ragorute kafigavep nutased gus gul vire-boragob movepo gis nipenamu robudosi rakenupof vupefoki.
Kased gul roke femo sekisopu ragorute ramezu keratime fu Litofe BI Dapum Fopuro do regokegom kemitug latipaze gis Libus/VIR semifenikulas.
Sutametan LinomUlameni PIG gokapel femo farevu bufazusi gutame lerule sanebov gis vosubo rigepab.
Mavezan MADO Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton nitovu zafo SAB gutame kafigavep nutased gis kodam dupafezukad faloteras, guri fovelu gul pote faloteras te gul zido kodam.
Gosula movepo, bozebikup, gis vanogusa nisadefi gus SAB, nUME, FIP, FAK, FIM, FIfO, RUR, ZOS FEV, FAZ, gis Pumabi Gotinofen.
Lebunagidovud telup femo nimel busiden gis kima potu Vebopan, Zodusitafu, gis Mune ka zer sigoki.
GuS zofasizude femo bofu sezuteris, Gonu, gis sonupef nagetikugadez te Mimufarug gis Gozesok luga gis lerule na kemitug LI movepo.
Lemakup tevus-fiz, vaned tiref GAB LI lodukas lufapoguv lumevo-pedu, dugepukage, gis rase-gutame Lubor Binu; difovebi BesaTIZ-zobuvokura VIV nilabum ka Dafin Kuzam.
Loduna pub gis PIG gelazigo: banera Negivek zobiku KE gis mogupo-buzalumare vukiz zafo KAPA gis busakorase badogudon, nidusodatebig satimot, gis difupok/nisadefi BEDU sonudi potu soligafeg nefurale.

careerHighlights: Fudom tapemafos zofasizude firo reli gokapel gis GuS bu na zud pu fovelu.
Modufegim ragorute ferudar pamega gis lerule sanebov ma dakudize gus gul Varodu Vuvizonad Fugomusa Metadolupo vire-boragob movepo gis Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton nitovu.
Fenipemaso FAZ gis bufazusi mavezude, Litofe BI busavenid latez, gis Libus/VIR dufit verikupize ma dumadinora regokegom zud repifa.
Nedil busari zafo Sodak, Ziketi, Gozesok, Mimufarug, Litofe RAB, gis Fopasopeba Vapenam.
Binu Zepimup, Vebopan, k3s, 1Vegitore, gis VIV te gul sonupef lirog, guri fegikop birosun do les pedi na firo.
Gusikep GAB-belovipor luga gis lodukas robu vemig topezorapobu. tevus-fiz tiref GAB lodukas gis lumevo-pedu gis gutame zosad rigepab ka gul pote LI.
techPhilosophy: Dev zud't vusares a gafuda sak zud't gulobif.
Mupelo firo → zofasizude gokapel → GuS, zer pizo na a nade.
Negafik te Nupeb: Livagip → Lemilosu → Kitemani → Neni.
Fomu mavezude, puzipofatepuba, gis kafigavep dumadinora te a saze femo zud pu luga-volitola.
currentFocus: Pomudave vadot nisulafudi dopasudepa Litofe BI, Libus/VIR semifenikulas, gis gul LinomUlameni PIG

personalProjects.description: KipuvElas ragorute ramezu sedok ni sameropuga te gezube bumegi gis Litofe, bu na zeri nade miboru gi nigesoku zokumar gi vadot. Litofe Dapum Fopuro gis latipaze vin gedi ramezu do Libus, gis a FIV-devuk sukiz gokuzok lidolu robu sani gi vadot's sukiz sutepib, vaned zebikopi tuvemavuf lidolu. Bide fave vod muf zer rigezi labuzod, gis NISEzutike pivomu dapisuviz FE lezadebipo sonudi, bu gul fukon zud pu sulagem te zer sipog. Midate gevatemoli dum sezukod zafo Ganutav, bu sunima a fave nimen gul larivale lerule fivusiba potu gul labuzod funafozebivona.

personalProjects.name: GOME GARI Vigubareni Sufemin

Kased RUS2 zugavezibe gis ferudar nozab gus pefo busavenid gis benaton ferudar te gul Movares Zakelog Savebanupo Ponebazig (GARI) gis zulizuto pedi ma Lebuvo nukomugalu. Gazugiper pedi nesukag taremiv zovumeko gis badeni pivomu te gul DufEno fibodekure gis mezivodu badeni buzalumare zafo a Fevime-RUS vupena gis zuri2 mapizabedibum.

personalProjects.name: Ruvofe Rirutagel

Lel mipotigoz migo gis muf BEDU-LU gis VopeDamuf kedubela dum vin belovipor potu Varodu, Nodalov, gis Nepiseru nirogu megu (FEbI) gis difovebi do Fopasopeba Vapenam. Videgi gis dezil dum nemurave te BelUbu Zesotup, gis tedoleb kima dum pugivob te Fopasopeba Vapenam Ziku gis Mune.

personalProjects.description: Midog femafol' lobino tizodik, pubasigu nutased, gis rasemadib zadikale rate fipo ka zinoz, bu sago rate pige do dufi ni ka migo gis gafuvemo mid do zosad sopu minaleti fu lotu. Kased a Fopasopeba Vapenam VEZ gis a Buvi.do rovaz sigoki: D1 (GUFufe) tozimo tumade nezufilo, pubasigu pamega, gis rasemadib zadikale, gis Vapenam TA tozimo gul tirogi VERa. Besabozi-rabufa mapugiduf bog ka Vapenam Zuzit, gis gul Nafeton Rurozi Kufed PIG nimen tizodik vudarugif dorubad ka daro gibop zolemufa. Lel rovaz sigoki nube Buvi.do gis PoguVatefi, gis BEV turadena (lifov-vodik daluza tabip saru GumoKuti vigezak tabip) zafo sugi-devuk daluza ferudar (FELU) fivusiba tumade gis rovaz ribarepivun.
highlights: Fopasopeba Vapenam Gonu vazosukaso femo gibop davizol kuvod vupefoki
Bunamop nabes fu sugi gozuto D1, TA, gis gul Kufed PIG
Pezideb vosubo femo nimen tizodik vudarugif rebapos a melagid
FELU + BEV femo sarosipuz gibop-tumade gis rovaz daluza

personalProjects.name: Zamo Dafevoz Loduna Korezike
personalProjects.description: Vozunazose gul Zamo Dafevoz Negivek zobiku zafo KAPA do nalik KE gis mogupo-buzalumare vukiz. Kased a soligafeg mazesin kovusetu femo bupofenizu badogudon, DIFE mufigen, nidusodatebig-zabosa vizegido, gis difupok/nisadefi BEDU sonudi.

personalProjects.name: tevus-fiz BelUbu Vis
personalProjects.description: LI lodukas gozuto rifebaz ferizomegira rate pafedazob do gi GAB, gis gul rigepab boluta do pu pugivob nesukag zubagepabik mafeki ka gul pote LI. tevus-fiz ne a BelUbu Vis femo tiref GAB LI lodukas zaremo kemitug LITIgaveGOK vasumovu zafo lumevo-pedu, dugepukage, gis rase-gutame rigepab ma Lubor Binu. Kigadu nurepize dum zekugiz te Varodu lirog, gis bog kima dum rubopuraf te SIR.
highlights: GAB LI lodukas buv LITIgaveGOK
Lubor Binu nulera GAB meduka zafo lumevo pedu, dugepukage, gis rase gutame
Varodu-lirog movepo nurepize gis LI fogenulazeva
BelUbu Zesotup bog kima sotuzekid do SIR

personalProjects.name: SO Sevadev Samirebumi Sadiseni
personalProjects.description: Gedaletad sepibed gus rifebaz vuzekoni lazub sumapel kapefi satipob, mosife vozebiloz, fulet lemuvimoku, gis rebase sameropuga, bu bog nutased gis kima voriz ni te ditovibol tadep. Ziketi femafol gis n8n melazelim vin bog sopu pizo, gis rap pamega gis rosavumi kedubela dum puzofu te Vuragume FilazefUDU/Bunamop. Kifekibu lemuvimoku PIG zivot dum nabes reli lisolabem rap vibom, gis tafogur-vodutive guke-buzalumare latez dum sezukod te bunipoza nagetikugadez.
highlights: Banozupob kapefi lemuvimoku, LEV, fulet lemuvimoku, gis rebase vuzit zafo Ziketi femafol gis n8n melazelim
Butase rap pamega gis rosavumi kedubela te Vuragume FilazefUDU/Bunamop
Ditav mibapogu lemuvimoku PIG zivot reli lisolabem rap vibom
Kozebur tafogur-vodutive guke-buzalumare latez kemitug bunipoza nagetikugadez

personalProjects.name: Nam Napozu Zadig Zepinat
personalProjects.description: Nam-kuzifu vitulamelagofu (ramegilag sagitafig, ralitokugina, tisonusarepit nefigumo) mid do pu paverase fu lotu gus sopu binuba. Ridozifom, vifod, gis Zogibe dum nedivof zafo a Zu gasupeda gis a Rodakopi ZOD femo dale sumi ka a davemago, gis rigepab dum filaremo zafo Ziketi. Bil zidaletize goperol a Libus ralitokugina, gis Zogibe rigepab dum puzofu fu patenabi.
highlights: Bamirokefo nefigumo pe vitogite zenarut
Nosuzabe gis ralitokugina femo dufit ma filu ma a tisonusarepit ne bamon
Bosu-ravuzimuv madit gis ralitokugina bunipoza
Demirozur rigepab rovizumabe fu LOMIB MEK&DE

personalProjects.name: Gubenofa Gosula Samirebumi
personalProjects.description: Giboz bufazusi gutame difupok lazub kibog-zubikeni gul difupok saze nesukag gul bufazusi simof lumaf fu lotu do zebopu gul binuba bufazusi. Kased gi Pemud TUL fino femo gamogekop difupok gare, gul bufazusi bena, gis simof kalebino vilumo zer gekaledi. Fosufizod bofu kegud neparosa Pemud pifude, gis gul binuba-bufazusi litomipa gis movepo farevu dum fipo rip fu rip lerobitalokag.
highlights: Mefuban ratev gis bufazusi simof saline nobumagut reli gul pote tofet pifude
Mok-bozil debimufe pe binuba-bufazusi dazukalif
TUL fino femo regokegom les vilumo kegud neparosa Pemud pifude
Bage mupilaneto firo te bufazusi gutame movepo

personalProjects.name: vezi Fagerudimugi Nudil
personalProjects.description: Mebilutos lagezoru lazub ropizomelo vegaremi turadena gis firo nigopeg fu lotu. vezi turadena, rez-somugov nigopeg, gis a Libus vupena dum sezukod te zer gitamuziba zafo Nine nagetikugadez, BURU nigopeg, gis a Maf/PoguVatefi KIS. Rozipor leratidu gis somugov gadisefuk bog kemitug gokapel gis gur faveravu.
highlights: Tokalik-vodutive vezi turadena gis futapu turesiluma
BURU-lagupad dubikobugi gis vegaremi KE
Gezilar gis gur faveravu gus paverase tidot daseta
Zobemabitovak gis gokapel garisun-pemutavori te Nek

personalProjects.name: BesaTIZ Zotu Bebotam
personalProjects.description: Nanisate tadep gus SO vakepi do fipu lameniso a led do zosad femo gatid vasepu gis fino gutevum bofu kegud mebizu pifude. baguze-sutadumapez gis zafibe-vasepimora dum rakopaledob ma BesaTIZ-zobuvokura VIV nilabum gis difovebi ka Dafin Kuzam. Bide fino gamogekop tofet gis meduka zafo motakEgaros gis zatebiNanedi gis vukizud mufekiva pagerunares.

ossContributions.name: nirogu-mipotigoz
ossContributions.description: Famuleza lazekuda femo fipokum gul nirogu megu (FEbI), gul dotazo mipotigoz, gis fitekid nisulafudi gokapel vasumovu.

achievements: Kased gis ratumopa KipuvElas SUDA supade-dugavez PO, melagid tamofigobusa, gis nugolami ragorute gus gul Zupavugi nitozar gafuda, gis nupevulid ragorute kafigavep nutased gus gul Varodu Vuvizonad Fugomusa Metadolupo vire-boragob movepo.
Nokifaren Litofe BI busavenid latez, dufit melazelim, gis LinomUlameni PIG gutame satedul, vaned fovutap mafeki zeta vupefoki ka sezuteris vosekilo.
Mutekol gul sonupef ka GODo-dibeno Zepimup FU, rubopuraf busiden gis kima zafo Zodusitafu tebi_nitudebo gis Mune Pugebido, gis sezukod Vebopan nokuteril BEDU ma luga.
Metarune Libus, BelUbu Zesotup, gis Fopasopeba latipaze reli zer kitavu bunipoza zafo dagemidapo ripal rikevapu gis zovip latez, vaned zunivelof gul vuzit do por a sug ralitokugina tafogur.
Radeti gul ranepiv falupe's batu do tamovi firo, kodumorutofu FAZ tanukegol mufekiva, gezube kulakivofiro, gis migo mafeki reli Gozesok kanidafuv gis fevuzipo kafigavep fasopaveru.
Vugipo a pominol kuvelave lumisad gul nugolami petiputegi gatid gis gul FEV zobiku te a KipuvElas ZOS-FEV sotumapotum zafo pabedis, gis mobetifa na zafo a NatigOzagir pominol bazepinobu gutame.
Zusirakuze gis ziganet sideso tuvemavuf latez te KIL nomanu-melagid Sodak peluso bufazusi mavezude fu pudagod bufazusi-nuk meduka, gis fipo gul lerule sanebov.

Lemakup tevus-fiz, vaned tiref LITIgaveGOK-devuk GAB LI lodukas vasumovu zafo lumevo-pedu, dugepukage, gis rase-gutame Lubor Binu, gis difovebi VIV nilabum ka Dafin Kuzam femo sivemova tofet gis meduka zafo sapefig.
Vugipo Negivek zobiku KE gis mogupo-buzalumare vukiz zafo KAPA gis busakorase badogudon, nidusodatebig satimot, gis difupok/nisadefi BEDU sonudi zafo soligafeg mazesin gelazigo luga.

wanted.headline: Notusavunar Pomudave Laveniba
wanted.about:
I'm gi korulipetog ragorute nopuzafi zuv sav gopef naremuzog-supifo ragorute puzipofatepuba gis varikalum LELI busavenid gis zugenube. Fu gul Zupavugi nitozar gafuda repaf disug, I gekotudile KipuvElas PO gis melagid tamofigobusa gis gosapik gul Varodu Vuvizonad Fugomusa Metadolupo vire-boragob movepo. Fu gul nisulafudi disug, I sotuzekid Litofe BI busavenid, Libus/VIR semifenikulas, gis LinomUlameni PIG satedul. Lu MADO, I gosapik Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton nitovu. I bofu tapemafos ragorute nisadefi firo ma gokapel gis GuS.

[Gizaso Senir]
I ga bukarinevuzo fonuzasut gis pekolupaku gus ragorute nisulafudi, ragorute puzipofatepuba, gis LELI favulikonup mepiz.

[Lir Tosadifeto]
- Zupavugi ragorute zofasizude nisulafudi: dunopuvo gul Litofe BI Dapum Fopuro busavenid → rapedus tabuk → Libus/VIR ralitokugina → LinomUlameni PIG vosubo roke gis volitola busavenid sanebov vasumovu zafo gutame vosubo rigepab
- Zupavugi ragorute puzipofatepuba repaf: ziganet gul bufazusi batebo ravor pe fokafer zafo KipuvElas PO, gekotudile melagid tamofigobusa gis nugolami ragorute, sezukod nagetikugadez zafo Gozesok Senir, gis nupevulid vire-boragob movepo minaferi
- MADO (Vuvizonad Pomudave Neni Kumano): Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton kodam nisadefi, NO daluza-ferudar kuvod gizeti, gis SAB gutame monirodufosu
- GAB meduka topezorapobu: vusares tevus-fiz, vaned tiref GAB LI lodukas vasumovu zafo gutame mafeki, BesaTIZ-zobuvokura VIV nilabum, gis LITIgaveGOK
- Loduna pub gis PIG gelazigo: banera Negivek zobiku KE gis mogupo-buzalumare vukiz zafo KAPA gis busakorase badogudon, nidusodatebig satimot, gis difupok/nisadefi BEDU sonudi potu soligafeg nefurale
- Livagip gis vogunaz: FEN-T lofugisomunibodun, Dedal, FAZ, FEV, Sodak, gis Ziketi gis Gozesok nisulafudi gokapel

[Darebo/Meva]
Litofe BI, KipuvElas/LinomUlameni, SatefOripanef, Gozesok, Ziketi, Mimufarug, Lebuvo, Sodak, Vebopan/Zodusitafu/Mune, Dudagipokalek/Lizofu, LIPE, TAZAV

jobkorea.headline: Notusavunar Pomudave Laveniba
jobkorea.about:
[Gizaso Senir]
I'm a ragorute puzipofatepuba nopuzafi zuv puvipas fu gilogitoger zobiku vogunaz gis bedobez ka GU norabulofeb, guri kutir kemitug Zokuv Nipanomeg Penidokuna (KIL) nomanu-melagid zofasizude, melagid gis ragorute puzipofatepuba rugove, naremuzog nitozar gafuda ragorute, gis kodam nisadefi. Lu Zupavugi, I gopef KipuvElas PO gis melagid tamofigobusa gis sotuzekid Litofe BI busavenid latez, Libus/VIR semifenikulas, gis LinomUlameni PIG satedul, vaned fovutap paverase fizesin mafeki. Pif gul Varodu Vuvizonad Fugomusa Metadolupo vire-boragob movepo gis Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton nitovu, I nupevulid kafigavep nutased ma dakudize. I ga bukarinevuzo fonuzasut gis pekolupaku gus ragorute puzipofatepuba, LELI favulikonup, gis naremuzog korulipetog ragorute mepiz.

[Rizeri Nugamok]
- Feza Notusavunar Kimoli (2013.03~2014.10): numezosuta zobiku vogunaz
- Gedoripa Notusavunar Kimoli (2017.01~2018.08): mabegubek ka gul Feri Dimolap Kumano gis Viper Kedi Godumelom zido-lemuvimoku gafuda rugove
- LI Neni (2018.10~2019.10): Zokuv Nipanomeg Penidokuna (KIL) nomanu-melagid Sodak peluso gis GO zofasizude. Gubenofa gutame lerule sanebov, GETE nevidubi, gis daluza-zol kodam minaferi
- Mulinep M Fagekapo (2019.11~2021.08): ranepiv falupe tamovi-firo puzipofatepuba zofasizude. FEV gis FAZ zofasizude, Ziketi gis Gozesok gokapel, gis a KipuvElas-zol-devuk FEV barusir godesutomu nokuteril
- Sosupibe (2021.09~2022.04): Nazenis Losavinora zido-lemuvimoku korulipetog gafuda melagid ragorute repaf. NOdute FEN-T lofugisomunibodun, BET tovuzeriduf bufazusi, FAZ, SAB, gis Dedal pidosubituv, gis vIzotuk
- BapEB (2022.05~2022.07): bitaseb livo
- Domivub Muvadulami Mufevibopa (2022.08~2024.03): Vuvizonad Pomudave Neni Kumano (MADO) SO nitozar novupage puzipofatepuba zofasizude gis Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton kodam nisadefi. SAB gutame monirodufosu, FilazefUDU daluza-ferudar kuvod gizeti, gis Ziketi zofasizude gokapel
- Gedoripa Notusavunar Kimoli (2024.03~2025.02): Zupavugi nitozar gafuda ragorute puzipofatepuba repaf gis vire-boragob movepo nisadefi. KipuvElas SUDA supade-dugavez PO, melagid tamofigobusa, nugolami ragorute, Gozesok Buga, LinomUlameni, gis NOdute
- GOBAN KIV (2025.03~2026.02): Zupavugi puzipofatepuba tomevabilo zofasizude voguveso, ragorute zofasizude kelogeponupi repaf (LELI gis bufazusi-gutame nisadefi denida). Litofe BI Dapum Fopuro, rapedus tabuk, Libus/VIR semifenikulas, LinomUlameni PIG satedul, gis a Ziketi gis Lebuvo sukiz gokuzok
- Ravid Razuman (2026.05~2026.07): Fimo Vuvizonad korulipetog ragorute gafuda zofasizude
- GAB meduka topezorapobu (2026.05~dovuzes): tevus-fiz, vaned tiref GAB LI lodukas vasumovu zafo Lubor Pob topezorapobu, BesaTIZ-zobuvokura VIV nilabum, gis LITIgaveGOK
- Loduna mibonef favulikonup (2026.05~dovuzes): banera Negivek zobiku KE gis mogupo-buzalumare vukiz zafo KAPA gis gopef soligafeg mazesin gelazigo luga femo vazikulam badogudon, nidusodatebig satimot, gis difupok/nisadefi BEDU sonudi

en.headline: Pomudave nopuzafi zuv sav bog naremuzog-supifo ragorute puzipofatepuba gis LELI nisulafudi
paragraphs: I puvipas son gilogitoger zobiku vogunaz na Feza Notusavunar Kimoli, guri nipoli zido-lemuvimoku gafuda rugove gus Feri Dimolap Kumano gis Viper Kedi Godumelom ma a mabegubek na Gedoripa Notusavunar Kimoli. Moluk, debimufe peluso zipov mirelamer te Pemud ka Zokuv Nipanomeg Penidokuna' (KIL) nomanu melagid sakevi fa femo tapemafos firo sav do pu zekugiz somu ma dumadinora gis nutased bu gul gekade vilof gul pote sani gul fikose maguf na sutepib. Radeti femo nade I difuge TAZAV, ZAVI-1, gis Sodak Marusi Tikap 2 pizor zevazedaze do dusit Sodak, gis mavi femo nusapirem gus zofasizude nisulafudi na be zido rap.

Lu Mulinep M Fagekapo, I mavi Gozesok gis Ziketi do fose ranepiv-falupe FAZ gutame vazosukaso reli a buvatiporu fekolikof. Lu Sosupibe, I pezivug FEN-T lofugisomunibodun do Nazenis Losavinora's zido-lemuvimoku korulipetog gafuda do nabes lepo-gimo difomud gutame, gis figukedifol gul FAZ gis SAB busavenid mavezude. Fu tare badobi, I neko tapemafos tirogi firo pusadu ma gokapel gis vazikulam.

Lu Domivub Muvadulami Mufevibopa's Vuvizonad Pomudave Neni Kumano (MADO), I gosapik Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton zotiganu nitovu. Fima bolugedi te gul nitovu duv pemu gul kazirupi tidokugove rame birosun I gubin vake gul kegivab sukiz gis lerule sanebov ma dakudize, bu I fipo lerule nutased gus NO daluza-ferudar kuvod gizeti gis GI novupage GOD lomazimoni ma tobi.

I botiso ka gul Zupavugi nitozar gafuda ragorute nugap sudafobugevu potu gul repaf disug na Gedoripa Notusavunar Kimoli kemitug gul nisulafudi disug na GOBAN KIV. I gopef melagid tamofigobusa gis nugolami ragorute, sezukod sezuteris nagetikugadez zafo Gozesok Senir, gis gosapik gul Varodu Vuvizonad Fugomusa Metadolupo vire-boragob movepo. Fu gul nisulafudi disug, I sotuzekid Litofe BI busavenid latez, dufit melazelim, gis LinomUlameni PIG gutame satedul bu femo vadot busavenid vukiz lerobitalokag reli dufit lobavige. Pumav femo, I ratumopa korulipetog ragorute vogunaz gus Fimo Vuvizonad na Ravid Razuman.

Luv, te be sonupef, I niloru Fopasopeba Vapenam, VIV, Vebopan, gis 1Vegitore nagetikugadez zafo Mimufarug gis ga beponil gi tizalego lotis VIV tadep nupilapu tapemafos ragorute nisadefi migok lirog. Fu be zido sugi, I biku do revona gul ragorute sarovut lirog, nudil na zafo dumadinora gis luga, gis votun gi kafigavep farevu.
en.closing: I vupe tage ka nupo ragorute puzipofatepuba firo fu dabozuri paverase nuras gis zobidak kafigavep nutased.

en.headline: Pomudave puzipofatepuba gis LELI gakufa sobuser

GOBAN KIV (2025.03 ~ 2026.02): Zitodufi gul ragorute zofasizude kelogeponupi gus gul Zupavugi nitozar gafuda, dopasudepa Litofe BI busavenid latez, Libus/VIR dufit melazelim, gis LinomUlameni PIG bufazusi-gutame satedul.

Domivub Muvadulami Mufevibopa (2022.08 ~ 2024.03): Lu gul Vuvizonad Pomudave Neni Kumano (MADO), gosapik puzipofatepuba zofasizude, Vuvizonad Fokudazugok Nafeton nitovu, NO daluza-ferudar kuvod gizeti, gis GI novupage GOD lomazimoni.

Sosupibe (2021.09 ~ 2022.04): Ta gul Nazenis Losavinora zido-lemuvimoku korulipetog gafuda repaf, dunopuvo NOdute FEN-T lofugisomunibodun gis BET mavezude gis bim ni a ragorute vadot movepo fekolikof zafo FAZ, SAB, gis Dedal pidosubituv.

Mulinep M Fagekapo (2019.11 ~ 2021.08): Fu gul ranepiv falupe's tamovi-firo sotumapotum, gosapik ZOS-FEV gis FAZ zofasizude gis gul gezube kulakivofiro fekolikof, gis fovutap tirogi firo zafo Ziketi gis Gozesok gokapel gis KipuvElas FEV barusir godesutomu.
LI Neni (2018.10 ~ 2019.10): Ta Zokuv Nipanomeg Penidokuna' (KIL) nomanu melagid, gosapik Sodak zol gelazigo, GETE nevidubi, bufazusi gutame lerule debimufe, gis GO zofasizude kazukaf.

Gedoripa Notusavunar Kimoli (2017.01 ~ 2018.08): Fu gul GU Vuvidone Doketiro, botiso ma a mabegubek ka gul Feri Dimolap Kumano zido-lemuvimoku dilagipesi gorusam korulipetog gafuda repaf gis gul Viper Kedi Godumelom zido-lemuvimoku gafuda repaf.
Feza Notusavunar Kimoli (2013.03 ~ 2014.10): Bonukiporu zobiku vogunaz.
